\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \min\,\Bigl\{\, v \;:\; h_{xy}(v) = \max_{u} h_{xy}(u) \,\Bigr\}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(h_{xy}(v)\): How often value v occurs in the window
- \(v, u\): Whole values from 0 to 255

h_xy(v) counts how often the whole value v occurs in the window around (x, y). The output is the value with the highest count. When several values share the highest count, the smallest of them wins, as in skimage.filters.rank.modal.
